content:
sam: Heads up — noticed a sharp stutter opening large dashboards in canary (~1761122300). Heatmap snap shows main thread stalls and a 1.2s LCP increase. screenshot: https://redwood/ops/shot/heatmap-17611223.png

maria: I can repro on EU region with dataset=orders-90d. Devtools shows parse+eval spike ~180ms and telemetry eager init ~220ms right after chunk parse.

kevin: Logging shows a bunch of `prefetch` requests returning 204 (no-content) for shared chunks around the same time. Could be prefetch soft-fail + retry storm. Sample from client logs: `GET /assets/chunk-42.prefetch.js 204 x 0ms` x 17

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed (id: canary-2026-03-19-2) 1761122300 -> 1761122315; rollout weight: 60% -> 80% (eu-primary).

anya: This smells like two things colliding: increased routing weight + eager telemetry import in the main bundle. If prefetch soft-fails, clients parse bigger bundle synchronously and telemetry init contends for main-thread. Proposal: temporary soft-fail mitigation — disable eager telemetry import and fall back prefetch to lazy-load on canary.

sam: Agree. What's the risk of flipping telemetry to lazy import? Any data loss or missing metrics?

maria: Telemetry is sampled before import; fallback means we'll miss some very early spans for those sessions but server-side traces are intact. Acceptable for a short hotfix.

kevin: Also found a routing policy change in the rollout config: `route.weight.eu = 0.8` changed yesterday. That increases client concentration on a smaller KV affinity set and likely bumped prefetch collisions. Reverting weight to 0.6 reduced concurrent prefetches in our staging test.

sam: Can we run a 5% canary with telemetry lazy and prefetch disabled? Steps I used to repro:
```
# open heavy dashboard
curl -H "x-region: eu" "https://console.local/dashboard?id=heatmap&dataset=orders-90d" -v
# watch chrome tracing, look for main-thread >100ms at parse/timeToInteractive
```

anya: I'll create a hotfix toggle and flip it for the canary. Pushing a small patch to config service now (`feature.console.prefetch_policy=soft-fail-lazy`) and setting telemetry import flag. Will also lower route.weight.eu back to 0.6 for the canary cohort.

deploy-bot: config patch staged: cfg-1761122338, will apply in 30s to canary group.

maria: Thanks — once applied I'll run the staged reproducibility script and report perf numbers. If LCP drops back under baseline we'll keep toggle for 24h and then plan a proper fix (split out telemetry into worker / idle-time init).

sam: Sounds good. If anyone sees other client-side 204s or parse spikes post-change ping here and tag @anya. :thumbsup:
